Package edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.item

Class Identification

java.lang.Object
edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.item.Identification
public class Identification extends Object
What the player knows about item kinds in this run. Each run shuffles which color belongs to which potion and which label belongs to which scroll. Drinking or reading an item of an unknown kind identifies the whole kind.
